notes: All clips below were checked on contact sheets, zoom sheets and a full-size proof frame. 'quote' is left empty throughout: no audio was listened to. YouTube blocked this session for a stretch (HTTP 403, then a bot check); it cleared with --js-runtimes node --extractor-args youtube:player_client=android, one download at a time. Station sites (Gray TV, CBS, ABC, PBS) downloaded directly. 16 videos were downloaded in all, slightly over the 12 asked for.
